title: Relabelling a native menu must cover its title and the predefined items, not only the items the app added
rule: When the native shell follows a UI setting (language, theme names), relabel every visible part of the menu it changes: the submenu's own title (Submenu::set_text) and Tauri's predefined items in it (About on Windows and Linux, via PredefinedMenuItem::set_text), not only the MenuItems the app inserted. Tauri's Menu::default builds those with English literals. Assert the submenu title and the predefined item texts in the ipc test after the switch.
rationale: E19.2 (#134): set_shell_locale relabelled the four Help page items but left the 'Help' title and 'About Font Manager' in English, so criterion 4 was only half delivered.
